description:
The Financial Assistance for Daughter's Marriage scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB).

This scheme was officially launched on 1st April 2019.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to the daughters of construction workers in Uttarakhand.

The scheme aims to promote the welfare of construction workers by alleviating the financial burden associated with marriage expenses.

Under this scheme, a financial assistance amount of INR 50,000 is provided for the marriage of each daughter.

The assistance is intended to help families manage the costs of weddings which can be substantial.

The scheme specifically targets families that are registered under the Building and Other Construction Workers Act, 1996.

To be eligible for this financial assistance, the applicant must be a registered construction worker in Uttarakhand.

The applicant must have contributed to the welfare fund for a minimum of one year.

The daughter for whom the assistance is sought must be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage.

The applicant must provide proof of the marriage such as a marriage certificate or a marriage invitation card.

Additionally, the applicant must submit an application form that is available at the local UKBOCWWB office or online on the official website.

The application process involves filling out the form with accurate personal details and submitting it along with the required documents.

Required documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhar card, proof of registration as a construction worker, and proof of the daughter's age.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the officials at the UKBOCWWB.

The review process typically takes about 30 days from the date of application submission.

If the application is approved, the financial assistance amount is disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant.

The disbursement is usually completed within 15 days of approval.

The scheme is implemented by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The board is responsible for the overall administration and management of the scheme.

The contact details for the UKBOCWWB can be found on their official website.

The board also provides additional support and information regarding other welfare schemes available for construction workers.

The Financial Assistance for Daughter's Marriage scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve the socio-economic conditions of construction workers in the state.

The scheme recognizes the unique challenges faced by construction workers, particularly in managing the costs associated with marriage.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a one-time grant per daughter.

This means that families with multiple daughters can apply for assistance for each daughter separately.

The scheme has been well-received by construction workers in Uttarakhand.

Since its launch, thousands of families have benefited from this assistance.

The government has allocated a significant budget for the implementation of this scheme.

In the financial year 2022-2023, the government allocated approximately INR 5 crores for this purpose.

The scheme has been instrumental in reducing the financial stress associated with marriage for many families.

It also encourages the education and empowerment of girls by relieving financial burdens.

The scheme aligns with the government's commitment to women's welfare and empowerment.

The UKBOCWWB conducts awareness programs to inform construction workers about this scheme.

These programs are held at various construction sites and community centers.

The board also collaborates with local NGOs to reach out to more beneficiaries.

As of October 2023, the scheme continues to be operational and is open for applications.

The financial assistance is credited to the applicant's bank account through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.

This ensures transparency and efficiency in the disbursement process.

The scheme has also been praised for its simplicity and ease of access.

The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the UKBOCWWB.

The board encourages eligible applicants to apply as soon as their daughter’s marriage date is confirmed.

This allows sufficient time for processing the application and disbursing the funds.

The scheme is part of a larger framework of social security measures for workers in the unorganized sector.

It reflects the government's recognition of the contributions made by construction workers to the economy.

The financial assistance for daughter’s marriage scheme is one of several initiatives aimed at improving the lives of construction workers.

Other welfare measures include health insurance, pension schemes, and skill development programs.

The UKBOCWWB is committed to enhancing the living standards of construction workers and their families.

The board regularly reviews and updates the scheme based on feedback from beneficiaries.

This ensures that the scheme remains relevant and effective in meeting the needs of construction workers.

The government is also exploring ways to expand the scheme to include additional benefits in the future.

Overall, the Financial Assistance for Daughter's Marriage scheme is a significant step towards supporting the families of construction workers in Uttarakhand.

It not only provides financial relief but also promotes the dignity and status of women in society.

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social welfare and gender equality.
